title: PS5 - What's a Good Deal since Price Hike?
body:
I'm eyeing a PS5 (/pro?) purchase with GTA 6 maybe hopefully actually coming out later this year.
Obviously missed the pre Q3 price hike deals and it seems like no decent deals have been posted ever since.
So I'm just curious, what would we consider a decent deal for the regular, disc and pro versions now?
Any hopes for prime day?
